headline: Reserve Bank of India to Conduct Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced it will conduct a 4-day Variable Rate Repo auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility to manage evolving liquidity conditions.
why: Variable Rate Repo auctions are key monetary policy instruments used by the central bank to manage short-term liquidity in the banking system and influence money market rates.

impacts.name: India interbank liquidity
impacts.why: A variable rate repo auction directly targets short-term interbank liquidity and repo rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
